subject: Simple relation conditions
notes: kb/Work PB1470 (wave 1039 A). The unnumbered closing sentence of 8.8.4.2.1 (cite.py stamps it '13)', PB222): 'A relation condition shall contain at least one reference to an operand that is not a literal.' It is neither a general format nor a syntax rule, so 4.2.2 asks the warning mechanism to indicate it ('This warning mechanism shall indicate violations of such rules'); the severity is latitude and follows GnuCOBOL 3.2, measured under WSL (-Wconstant-expression / -Wconstant-numlit-expression warnings, the program compiles): WARNING COBOL3146 at 85, 2002, 2014 and 2023, the relation evaluated as written (docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-RELLITERAL). Asked where a relation condition is written (ConditionBinder.WrittenRelational: IF, PERFORM UNTIL, SEARCH WHEN, a boolean relation, an abbreviated relation's inserted subject, an EVALUATE partial-expression per 14.9.13.3 SR8) by StatementValidation.CheckRelationHasNonLiteralOperand. A figurative constant (8.3.3.6 under 8.3.3 Literals), a symbolic-character (8.3.2.2.29 'a user-defined figurative constant') and a constant-name (13.10.4 GR1 'as if literal-1 ... were written') are literals; a data item, an arithmetic expression (IF 1 + 1 = 2) and a function-identifier folded or not (8.4.3.2.1) are not. RelationLiteralOperandTests checks every ordered pair of 16 operand kinds against the rule and every relation surface with the EVALUATE pair/range complement (14.9.13.3 SR10 Table 15 governs those, refusing literal/literal and permitting a range against a literal subject). The golden 85/pb1470_relation_of_two_literals_runs pins the spec-computed values (8.8.4.2.7 rule 2 padding; 14.9.28.4 GR10 for PERFORM UNTIL 1 = 1). The other halves of the row (item 13 variable-length groups, PB1467; group-as-elementary-alphanumeric, alphabetic-as-alphanumeric, national/bit group, the numeric-edited NOTE) were verified or landed earlier (wave 65 A). retired-witness: conformance:RelationLiteralOperandTests (malformed form (a Conformance-assembly test class is cited as conformance-test:<Class>.<Method>); re-cited as its three methods by the train 1039b lander)
